New & Uncertain.meaning: Member is newly enrolled or has insufficient transaction history to reliably classify. Too few data points to determine behavioral archetype.
New & Uncertain.recommended_action: Send onboarding journey — guide first meaningful purchase

Win-Back Target.meaning: Member lapsed 60+ days ago but is showing early re-engagement signals — they opened an email, visited the app, or made a small purchase. The window for recovery is now.
Win-Back Target.recommended_action: Send personalised win-back offer referencing last purchase category

Lapse Risk.meaning: Member is still active but engagement is clearly declining — fewer transactions, growing gaps between visits. Without intervention within 30 days, they will fully lapse.
Lapse Risk.recommended_action: Send urgency-framed win-back offer — highlight expiring points balance

Brand Advocate.meaning: Member is deeply engaged across every channel — they open emails, use the app, hold a high loyalty tier, and shop across multiple categories.
Brand Advocate.recommended_action: Send referral incentive — double points for friend referrals

Redemption Hunter.meaning: Member is primarily motivated by point redemption. They redeem a high fraction of earned points, often spiking activity around promotional events.
Redemption Hunter.recommended_action: Send promo expiry alert — create urgency around point balance

Value Maximizer.meaning: Member strategically optimises their earn rate — shops across multiple categories and redeems at optimal moments. Price-conscious but loyal when the value proposition is clear.
Value Maximizer.recommended_action: Send cross-category bonus earn offer — show where they can maximise points

Momentum Builder.meaning: Member is on an upward trajectory — purchase frequency and spend are actively increasing. Most likely to move up a tier in the next 60 days.
Momentum Builder.recommended_action: Send tier upgrade nudge — show proximity to next tier

Silent Accumulator.meaning: Member is purchasing regularly but completely invisible in digital channels — no app opens, no email opens, no push notifications clicked. They earn points but never engage with loyalty communications.
Silent Accumulator.recommended_action: Send app download incentive — bonus points for first in-app purchase

Plateau Cruiser.meaning: Member is stable and habitual — consistent purchasing with no growth or decline signal. Comfortable where they are and unlikely to move up a tier without a nudge.
Plateau Cruiser.recommended_action: Send personalised offer based on most-purchased category

Program Skeptic.meaning: Member is enrolled but shows minimal engagement with the programme — low app use, ignores communications, and minimal profile completion. The loyalty programme is not influencing their behaviour.
key_signals: catch-all — no other state rule fired
Program Skeptic.recommended_action: Send reactivation email — focus on programme value proposition
